scope: All four box lower bounds L0/L1/L2/L3 for an actual function on any convex subset of R^3, with its genuine gradient and symmetric Hessian. Proves first and second chain rules on the center-to-point segment, exact mean-value and second-order Taylor formulas by Rolle, the radius bounds for all linear/diagonal/off-diagonal terms, the exact quadratic supporting-plane identity, and minimization of each affine coordinate at its two endpoints. Includes the three unconditional bounds for the L3=-infinity branch. The L3 input is exactly the manuscript uniform numerical support-expression inequality; no function lower bound or own Taylor conclusion is assumed.
